shopOps.page.title: Shop governance
shopOps.page.description: Suspend open shops (their listed products are taken down in cascade); resuming only restores trading, it never re-lists products.
shopOps.col.name: Shop name
shopOps.suspend.dialogDescription: Suspend "{name}"? Its listed products are taken down together and hidden from buyers at once. Resuming will not re-list them automatically.
shopOps.resume.dialogDescription: Resume "{name}"? The shop is trading again, but products already taken down won't be re-listed automatically (the seller must relist them).
